_about: Answer key for the quality check (scripts/quality-check.js). Never copied into the scratch project.
Paths are as they appear in the scratch project, after the runner's renames (dot-claude -> .claude, *.fixture -> *).
A finding catches a bug when its file is one of `files` (or it names no file and `fileless` is true) and either
its line falls inside one of the bug's `lines` windows (only when `lineMatch` is true, widened by 1 line each side)
or its text satisfies `match`: a list of alternatives, each a list of case-insensitive regexes that must ALL match.
The text is the finding's what, context, fix, key and attachment values (raw JSONL), or its report lines (survivors).

bugs.description: Search keeps a note only when indexOf(query) > 0, so a note that starts with the search word never matches.
The static handler joins decodeURIComponent(pathname) onto public/ with no containment check, so /..%2fserver.js serves files outside public/.
Clear all deletes every note on one click, with no confirmation or undo, styled the same as Export beside it.
app.js looks up #search-box but the page has #search, so the script throws at load and the note list never renders.
The plan decides export is CSV with a header row; /api/export returns JSON.
reset-notes.md forbids deleting or overwriting data/notes.json, then its step 2 deletes it.
The change adds lodash 4.17.15, below the fix for CVE-2020-8203 (prototype pollution) and later advisories.
The README's title and opening became 'nb-srv' and a jargon line, so a newcomer no longer learns what the app is.
Known-answer case (the #152 miss): failglob is on globally, and nullglob does not override it, so an empty backups/ aborts the script with 'no match'; the comment claims the opposite.
